gold_answers.higher_poi: Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM

output.higher_poi: Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM

gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.358596 37.287518)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.358596 37.287518)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.960317 35.59114)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.960317 35.59114)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Fantastic Caverns, Springfield, MO'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-106.960317, 35.59114), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
fcaverns_elev AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(fc.geom, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us, fcaverns_geom fc
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(fc.geom, 4326))
),
ojito_elev AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(oj.geom, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us, ojito_geom oj
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(oj.geom, 4326))
)
SELECT 
  'Fantastic Caverns, Springfield, MO' AS name,
  fc.elevation
FROM fcaverns_elev fc
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM' AS name,
  oj.elevation
FROM ojito_elev oj
ORDER BY elevation DESC
LIMIT 1;
